* fix(sort): sticky notices; the gate voices them only until reveal; hold compare after a 409 (purses-w7ss.11)

- decisionFlusher keeps the current notice per kind and replays it on
  subscribe; dismissNotice(kind) clears it; a 2xx clears auth_required.
  session_conflict now carries its sessionId.
- CompareChoice holds (aria-disabled, nothing queued, no Undo) only on
  its own sort's conflict.
- PendingDecisionsGate: one fixed tree shape; its PendingNotices speaks
  only until reveal; GATE_SIGNIN_LINE moves to AUTH_REQUIRED_NOTICE in
  pendingNotices. The gate ignores replayed notices so a leftover
  auth_required never skips the post-recovery refresh.
- Results page and the sort page's done phase gain their one
  PendingNotices.
- pendingNotices.test.tsx: dismiss every kind in beforeEach (sticky
  engine state otherwise leaks between tests).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BfKskkWb3LMmPkFkdDYp9s

* fix(sort): notice clears reach mounted surfaces (purses-w7ss.11)

PendingNotices reads the engine's notice set through useSyncExternalStore
(subscribeNoticeSet/getNoticeSet), so a 2xx clearing auth_required or a
dismissNotice removes the line from a surface that is already mounted, and
the set is read at render (no mount-effect replay gap).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BfKskkWb3LMmPkFkdDYp9s

* fix(sort): one live notice region; Sign in back to the round; Reload after a sort closed elsewhere (purses-w7ss.11)

PendingNotices is one always-mounted live region (role=status,
aria-atomic=false). auth_required offers Sign in to
/login?callbackUrl=<this path> and has no Okay; session_conflict offers
Reload; the rest offer Okay, which calls dismissNotice. A session_conflict
shows only where the surface's sessionId matches the conflict's, so the
results page and the gate (no sessionId) never show one. The sort page's
pairs and done phases and TriageRound pass their sessionId.

Status queries scoped (two status regions now): TriageRound.test announcer.
usePathname added to the next/navigation mocks in TriageRound.test and
sort/page.test.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BfKskkWb3LMmPkFkdDYp9s

* fix(sort): recovery-time conflicts get their own notice; Okay/Reload click tests (purses-w7ss.11)

A batch 409 during a recovery drain now emits closed_session_discarded
(no sessionId; any surface voices it, Okay dismisses) instead of a
session_conflict that no surface would show while the queue is deleted.
Mid-round 409s keep session_conflict + Reload.

Tests: the gate's recovery-409 test shows the new line (no conflict line)
and Okay removes it; Reload click calls location.reload; the
other-sort conflict test has a matching-session positive control.

* fix(sort): sticky notices; the gate voices them only until reveal; hold compare after a 409 (purses-w7ss.11)

- decisionFlusher keeps the current notice per kind and replays it on
  subscribe; dismissNotice(kind) clears it; a 2xx clears auth_required.
  session_conflict now carries its sessionId.
- CompareChoice holds (aria-disabled, nothing queued, no Undo) only on
  its own sort's conflict.
- PendingDecisionsGate: one fixed tree shape; its PendingNotices speaks
  only until reveal; GATE_SIGNIN_LINE moves to AUTH_REQUIRED_NOTICE in
  pendingNotices. The gate ignores replayed notices so a leftover
  auth_required never skips the post-recovery refresh.
- Results page and the sort page's done phase gain their one
  PendingNotices.
- pendingNotices.test.tsx: dismiss every kind in beforeEach (sticky
  engine state otherwise leaks between tests).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BfKskkWb3LMmPkFkdDYp9s

* fix(sort): notice clears reach mounted surfaces (purses-w7ss.11)

PendingNotices reads the engine's notice set through useSyncExternalStore
(subscribeNoticeSet/getNoticeSet), so a 2xx clearing auth_required or a
dismissNotice removes the line from a surface that is already mounted, and
the set is read at render (no mount-effect replay gap).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BfKskkWb3LMmPkFkdDYp9s

* fix(sort): one live notice region; Sign in back to the round; Reload after a sort closed elsewhere (purses-w7ss.11)

PendingNotices is one always-mounted live region (role=status,
aria-atomic=false). auth_required offers Sign in to
/login?callbackUrl=<this path> and has no Okay; session_conflict offers
Reload; the rest offer Okay, which calls dismissNotice. A session_conflict
shows only where the surface's sessionId matches the conflict's, so the
results page and the gate (no sessionId) never show one. The sort page's
pairs and done phases and TriageRound pass their sessionId.

Status queries scoped (two status regions now): TriageRound.test announcer.
usePathname added to the next/navigation mocks in TriageRound.test and
sort/page.test.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BfKskkWb3LMmPkFkdDYp9s

* fix(sort): recovery-time conflicts get their own notice; Okay/Reload click tests (purses-w7ss.11)

A batch 409 during a recovery drain now emits closed_session_discarded
(no sessionId; any surface voices it, Okay dismisses) instead of a
session_conflict that no surface would show while the queue is deleted.
Mid-round 409s keep session_conflict + Reload.

Tests: the gate's recovery-409 test shows the new line (no conflict line)
and Okay removes it; Reload click calls location.reload; the
other-sort conflict test has a matching-session positive control.
